14. The base radius and the height of a right circular cone \(W\) are 80 cm and 192 cm respectively. The circular cone is then divided into a right circular cone \(X\), a small frustum \(Y\) and a large frustum \(Z\) by two planes parallel to its base. It is given that the base radius of the right circular cone \(X\) is 5 cm .

(a) Find the height and the volume of the right circular cone \(X\).

(b) (i) Find the curved surface area of the right circular cone \(X\).
(ii) Given that frustum \(Y\) is similar to frustum \(Z\), find the total surface area of the frustum \(Y\).
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐 \(W\) 的底半徑及高分別為 \(80\) cm 及 \(192\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\)、一個小截頭錐 \(Y\) 及一個大截頭錐 \(Z\)。已知圓錐 \(X\) 的底半徑為 \(5\) cm。

(a) 求圓錐 \(X\) 的高及體積。

(b) 

(i) 求圓錐 \(X\) 的曲面面積。
(ii) 已知截頭錐 \(Y\) 與截頭錐 \(Z\) 相似，求截頭錐 \(Y\) 的總表面積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of the right circular cone \(X\). \[\frac{h}{192} =\frac{5}{80} \\ h =12\] The height of the right circular cone \(X\) is 12 cm . The volume of right circular cone \(X=\frac{1}{3} \pi(5)^{2}(12)\) \(=100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\left(314 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\right)\) Alternative Solutions: The volume of right circular cone \(W=\frac{1}{3} \pi(80)^{2}(192)\) \(=409600 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of the right circular cone \(X\). \(\frac{V}{409600 \pi} =\left(\frac{5}{80}\right)^{3} \\ V =100 \pi\) The volume of right circular cone \(X\) is \(100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\left(314 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\right)\) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of the right circular cone \(X\). \(\frac{1}{3} \pi(5)^{2} h =100 \\ h =12\) The height of the right circular cone \(X\) is 12 cm . (b) (i) The slant height of circular cone \(X=\sqrt{12^{2}+5^{2}} \mathrm{~cm}=13 \mathrm{~cm}\) \[\text { The curved surface area } =\pi(5)(13) \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =65 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(204 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\right)\] (ii) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the lower base radius of frustum \(Y\). Then the upper base radius of frustum \(Z\) is also \(r \mathrm{~cm}\). \(\frac{5}{r}=\frac{r}{80}\) \(r=20\) or \(r=-20\) (reject) Let \(A \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) the curved surface area of the right of frustum \(Y\). \( \frac{65 \pi}{65 \pi+A}=\left(\frac{5}{20}\right)^{2} \\ \qquad A=975 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ \therefore \text { The total surface area of the frustum } Y =\left[\pi(5)^{2}+\pi(20)^{2}+975 \pi\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =1400 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(4400 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\right)\) (8 marks)

13. The baige radius and the height of an inverted right circular conical vessel are 18 cm and 24 cm respectively. Water is poured into the vessel until the depth of water is 8 cm .

(a) Find the volume of water in terms of \( \pi \).
(2 marks)
(@) A metal sphere of radius 3 cm is put into the vessel. The sphere is totally immersed in the water.

(i) Find the depth of water.
(ii) Someone claims that the wet surface area of the vessel is increased by more than \( 24 \% \) after the sphere is put into the vessel. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器的底半徑及高分別為 \(18\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。將水倒入容器至水深 \(8\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求水的體積。（2 分）

(b) 將一個半徑 \(3\) cm 的金屬球放入容器，球完全浸入水中。

(i) 求水深。
(ii) 某人聲稱放入球後，容器的濕表面積增加超過 \(24\%\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
(a) Similarity gives the water radius \(r=3h/4\), so \(V(h)=3\pi h^3/16\). At depth 8 cm, \(V=96\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(b)(i) The immersed sphere displaces \(\frac43\pi(3)^3=36\pi\text{ cm}^3\). Thus \(3\pi h^3/16=132\pi\), giving \(h=\sqrt[3]{704}\approx8.896\text{ cm}\).

(ii) The cone slant length up to depth h is \(5h/4\), so its wet area is \(15\pi h^2/16\). The percentage increase is \(100[(704^{1/3}/8)^2-1]\approx23.65\%\), below 24%. Disagree.

questions.stem:
13. There are two similar inverted right circular conical vessels. For the larger vessel, the base radius and the slant height are \(45\) cm and \(51\) cm respectively. It is given that the ratio of the curved surface area of the larger vessel to that of the smaller vessel is \(9:4\).

(a) Express the capacity of the smaller vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is now poured into the larger vessel. Then, four solid metal spheres of radius \(6\) cm are put into the vessel and are totally immersed. The water that overflows is then collected by the smaller vessel.

(i) Express the volume of water overflowed in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the smaller vessel does not exceed \(670\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個相似的倒置直立圓錐形容器。較大容器的底半徑及斜高分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(51\) cm。已知較大容器與較小容器的曲面面積比為 \(9:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示較小容器的容量。

(b) 現將 \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水倒入較大容器，再放入四個半徑 \(6\) cm 的實心金屬球，球完全浸入水中。溢出的水由較小容器盛載。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求溢出的水體積。
(ii) 某人聲稱較小容器的濕曲面面積不超過 \(670\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.

球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of the larger vessel is \[\sqrt{51^2-45^2}=24\text{ cm}.\] The capacity of the larger vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\] Since the ratio of curved surface areas is \(9:4\), the linear scale factor from the larger vessel to the smaller vessel is \(3:2\), and the volume scale factor is \(27:8\). Therefore, the capacity of the smaller vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right)^{3/2}=4800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) The volume overflowed is \(15500\pi+4\left(\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3\right)-\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\) Thus the volume overflowed is \(452\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (ii) The area of the wet curved surface in the smaller vessel is \[\pi(45)(51)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right) \left(\frac{452\pi}{4800\pi}\right)^{2/3}.\] This is approximately \[663.2564917\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[663.2564917<670,\] the claim is agreed.

11. An inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 12 cm and height 9 cm contains water to a depth of 6 cm . All the water in the vessel is now poured into an empty right circular cylindrical cup without overflow and the depth of water is 12.8 cm .

(a) Find the base radius of the cylindrical cup. Leave your answer in surd form.

(b) A solid metal sphere with surface area equal to one-fifth of the curved surface area of the vessel is then put into the cylindrical cup. The metal sphere is completely immersed in water and no water spills out of the cup. Find the rise in water level in the cylindrical cup.
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個底半徑 \(12\) cm、高 \(9\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器盛水至深度 \(6\) cm。現將全部水倒入一個空直立圓柱杯且沒有溢出，水深為 \(12.8\) cm。

(a) 求圓柱杯的底半徑，答案以根式表示。

(b) 再將一個實心金屬球放入圓柱杯，其表面積等於容器曲面面積的五分之一。球完全浸入水中且沒有水溢出。求圓柱杯水位的上升高度。

球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution:
11.(a) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the water surface in the vessel. \(\frac{r}{12} =\frac{6}{9} \\ r =8\) 
 Let \(R \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the cylindrical cup. \(\pi R^{2} \times 12.8 =\frac{1}{3} \pi\left(8^{2}\right)(6) \\ R =\sqrt{10}\) 
 ∴ The base radius of the cylindrical cup is \(\sqrt{10} \mathrm{~cm}\). (b) Slant height of the curved surface in the vessel \(=\sqrt{12^{2}+9^{2}}=15 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Let \(s \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the sphere. \[\pi \times 12 \times 15=5 \times 4 \pi s^{2} \\ s=3 \\ \text { Rise in water level } =\frac{4}{3} \pi(3)^{3} \div \pi(\sqrt{10})^{2} \\ =3.6 \mathrm{~cm}\]

questions.stem:
11. An inverted right circular conical vessel contains some water. The vessel is held vertically. The depth of water in the vessel is \(12\text{ cm}\). \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is poured into the vessel. It is given that the depth of water in the vessel becomes \(18\text{ cm}\).

(a) Find the final volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is at most \(1100\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器盛有一些水，容器垂直放置。水深為 \(12\) cm。再倒入 \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水後，水深變為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器中最終的水體積。

(b) 某人聲稱容器的濕曲面面積最多為 \(1100\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.
questions.hintZh:
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 11. (a) Let the final volume of water be \(x\text{ cm}^3\). Since the depths before and after pouring are \(12\text{ cm}\) and \(18\text{ cm}\), the volume ratio is \[12^3:18^3=8:27.\] Thus \[\frac{x-950\pi}{x}=\frac{8}{27}.\] Hence \[27(x-950\pi)=8x.\] So \[19x=25650\pi,\] and \[x=1350\pi.\] Therefore, the final volume is \[1350\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the radius of the water surface after pouring. Then \[\frac13\pi r^2(18)=1350\pi.\] Hence \[ r=15. \] The slant height of the wet cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+18^2}=\sqrt{549}.\] The wet curved surface area is \[\pi(15)\sqrt{549}\approx 1104.148\text{ cm}^2.\] Since this is greater than \(1100\text{ cm}^2\), I disagree with the claim.

(a) Find \(r\).

(b) Initially, there is some water in a container with a depth of \(h \mathrm{~cm}\). A hemispherical bowl is used to pour water into the container. After pouring \(5 \frac{1}{4}\) bowls of water into the container without overflowing, the depth of the water increases to \(4 h \mathrm{~cm}\). Find \(h\).
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個半球形碗的半徑為 \(r\) cm。一個底半徑 \(36\) cm、高 \(48\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器垂直放置。容器的外曲面面積為碗的 \(7.5\) 倍。

(a) 求 \(r\)。

(b) 最初容器中有一些水，深度為 \(h\) cm。用半球碗將水倒入容器，倒了 \(5\frac{1}{4}\) 碗水後沒有溢出，水深增加至 \(4h\) cm。求 \(h\)。
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution:
(a) The cone slant height is 60 cm, so \(7.5(2\pi r^2)=\pi(36)(60)\), giving r = 12 cm.
(b) The added volume is \(\frac{21}{4}\frac23\pi(12)^3=6048\pi\text{ cm}^3\). If the initial water volume is V, quadrupling its depth multiplies its volume by 64. Thus \(63V=6048\pi\) and \(V=96\pi\). The cone capacity is \(\pi(36)^2(48)/3=20736\pi\text{ cm}^3\). Therefore \((h/48)^3=96/20736=1/216\), giving h = 8 cm.

13. A closed vessel with some water, which is in the form of an inverted right circular cone. The base radius and the height of the cone are 18 cm and 24 cm respectively. Kelly finds that the depth of water in the vessel is 8 cm.

(a) (i) Find the radius of the water surface.
(ii) Find the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Kelly turns the vessel upside down.

(i) Find the new depth of water, correct to 1 decimal place.
(ii) Kelly claims that the wet curved surface of the vessel has increased. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
一個封閉的倒置直立圓錐形容器內有一些水。圓錐底半徑為 18 cm、高為 24 cm，初始水深為 8 cm。
(a)(i) 求水面半徑。
(ii) 以圓周率表示容器的濕曲面面積。
(b) Kelly 把容器上下倒轉。
(i) 求新水深，準確至一位小數。
(ii) Kelly 聲稱容器的濕曲面面積增加了。你是否同意？解釋答案。（7 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.

排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a)(i) Let \(r\) cm be the radius of the water surface. By similar triangles, \[\frac{r}{18}=\frac{8}{24}.\] Thus \(r=6.\) The radius of the water surface is \(6\) cm. (a)(ii) The slant height of the wet cone is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10.\) The wet curved surface area is \(\pi(6)(10)=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (b)(i) The volume of water is \(\frac13\pi(6)^2(8)=96\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) The capacity of the vessel is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) The volume of the empty space is \(2592\pi-96\pi=2496\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Let \(H\) cm be the height of the empty cone after turning the vessel upside down. By similarity, \(\frac{\frac13\pi\left(\frac{18}{24}H\right)^2H}{2592\pi}=\frac{2496}{2592}.\) Equivalently, \(\left(\frac{H}{24}\right)^3=\frac{26}{27}.\) Thus \(H\approx 23.69996855.\) The new depth of water is \(24-23.69996855\approx0.3\text{ cm}.\) (b)(ii) Let \(R\) cm be the radius of the empty cone after turning the vessel upside down. Then \(\frac{R}{18}=\frac{H}{24},\) so \(R\approx17.77497641.\) The slant height of the empty cone is \(\sqrt{H^2+R^2}\approx29.62496069.\) The curved surface area of the whole cone is \(\pi(18)(30)=540\pi.\) The dry curved surface area is approximately \(\pi(17.77497641)(29.62496069)\approx526.6\pi.\) Therefore the new wet curved surface area is approximately \(540\pi-526.6\pi=13.4\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since \(13.4\pi<60\pi,\) the wet curved surface has not increased. I do not agree with Kelly's claim. (7 marks)

(b) 兩個容器均垂直放置，半球容器完全注滿水，現將水倒入圓錐容器。

14. The base of a solid right pyramid is a square of side \(20\) cm. The height of the pyramid is \(18\) cm.

(a) The pyramid is inverted and divided into a frustum and a smaller pyramid by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of the frustum is \(9\) cm. Find the volume of the frustum.

(b) A container consists of two parts with a common base. The upper part is the frustum described in (a) and the lower part is a cuboid of height \(8\) cm. Water is poured into the container to a depth of \(11\) cm. Find the volume of the water in the container.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(20\) cm 的正方形，高為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 將錐體倒置，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐及一個小錐體。已知截頭錐高 \(9\) cm，求截頭錐的體積。

(b) 一個容器由兩部分組成，共享同一底面。上部為 

(a) 所述的截頭錐，下部為高 \(8\) cm 的長方體。將水倒入容器至深度 \(11\) cm，求容器中水的體積。
（7 分）

錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。

排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the original pyramid is \[\frac13(20)^2(18)=2400\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[18-9=9\text{ cm}.\] The ratio of the heights of the smaller pyramid and the original pyramid is \[9:18=1:2.\] Therefore, the ratio of their volumes is \[1^3:2^3=1:8.\] The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac{1}{8}(2400)=300\text{ cm}^3.\] Hence the volume of the frustum is \[2400-300=2100\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The lower cuboid has square base of side \(10\) cm, so the volume of water in the cuboid is \[10^2(8)=800\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the water depth is \(11\) cm, the height of water in the frustum is \[11-8=3\text{ cm}.\] The corresponding similar pyramids have heights \(12\) cm and \(9\) cm, so their height ratio is \[12:9=4:3.\] The volume of the pyramid of height \(9\) cm is \(300\text{ cm}^3\). Thus the volume of the pyramid of height \(12\) cm is \[300\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^3=\frac{6400}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of water in the frustum part is \[\frac{6400}{9}-300=\frac{3700}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] The total volume of water is \[800+\frac{3700}{9} =\frac{10900}{9} \approx 1210\text{ cm}^3\] correct to 3 significant figures.

（a）原角錐 = 2400。小角錐高 9，比 1:2，體積比 1:8，小角錐 = 300，截頭錐 = 2100 cm³。
（b）下方長方體底邊 10，水 = 800，水深 8，總深 11 cm。

questions.stem: 14. A right circular cone is cut into three parts by two planes parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of the upper part of the cone are 6 cm and 20 cm respectively. (a) Find the volume of the upper part of the cone in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks) (b) If the height of the middle part is 10 cm, find the volume of the middle part. questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分。圓錐上部的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(20\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐上部的體積。（2 分）

(b) 若中間部分的高為 \(10\) cm，求中間部分的體積。（3 分）

(c) 下部的高為 \(10\) cm。Amy 聲稱下部的曲面面積多於 \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the upper cone is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(20)=240\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (2 marks) (b) Since the planes are parallel to the base, the cones are similar. The upper cone has height 20 cm and radius 6 cm. For the cone formed by the upper and middle parts, its height is \[20+10=30\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its radius is \[6\cdot\frac{30}{20}=9\text{ cm}.\] Hence the volume of the cone formed by the upper and middle parts is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(9)^2(30)=810\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of the middle part is \[810\pi-240\pi=570\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (c) The whole cone has height \[20+10+10=40\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its base radius is \[6\cdot\frac{40}{20}=12\text{ cm}.\] The radius at the top of the lower part is \(9\) cm, and the radius at the bottom of the lower part is \(12\) cm. The height of the lower part is \(10\) cm, so its slant height is \[\sqrt{10^2+(12-9)^2}=\sqrt{109}\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the lower frustum is \[\pi(9+12)\sqrt{109}=21\sqrt{109}\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[21\sqrt{109}>200,\] the curved surface area is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Therefore, I agree with Amy's claim. (4 marks)

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Z\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的總表面積之和。\(Z\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。

questions.solution: 14. (a) For the bottom frustum \(Z\), the lower radius is 20 cm and the height is 12 cm. Its upper plane is at a distance \[48-12=36\text{ cm}\] from the vertex of the original cone. By similarity of cones, the upper radius of \(Z\) is \[20\left(\frac{36}{48}\right)=15\text{ cm}.\] The volume of \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)(20^2+20\cdot 15+15^2)\] \[=4\pi(400+300+225) =3700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{12^2+(20-15)^2}=13.\] The total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2\] \[=455\pi+400\pi+225\pi =1080\pi.\] Since \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the lower radius of \(Y\) is the upper radius of \(Z\), the linear scale factor from \(Z\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{15}{20}=\frac34.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(Y\) is \[1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(S\) is \[1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }Z} =\frac{1687.5\pi}{1080\pi} =\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }Z}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2 =\frac{16}{9}.\] Since \[\frac{25}{16}\ne\frac{16}{9},\] \(Z\) and \(S\) are not similar. (4 marks)

14. A right circular cylindrical container of base radius 12 cm and height 16 cm and an inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 30 cm and height 15 cm are held vertically. The container is fully filled with water. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

(a) Find the volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks)

(b) Find the depth of water in the vessel. (4 marks)

(c) If a solid metal sphere of radius 4 cm is then put into the vessel and the sphere is totally immersed in the water, will the water overflow? Explain your answer. (3 marks)

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐容器中水的體積。（2 分）

(b) 求圓錐容器中水深。（4 分）

(c) 若再將一個半徑 \(4\) cm 的實心金屬球放入圓錐容器，球完全浸入水中，水會否溢出？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）

(c) The remaining volume of the conical vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(30)^2(15)-2304\pi=2196\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The volume of the sphere is \(\frac{4}{3}\pi(4)^3=\frac{256}{3}\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Since \(\frac{256}{3}\pi<2196\pi,\) the water will not overflow. questions.solution: The total volume of metal is \(84(20)=1680\text{ cm}^3.\) The ratio of corresponding lengths of the smaller pyramid to the larger pyramid is \(\sqrt{4:9}=2:3.\) Hence the ratio of their volumes is \(8:27.\) (a) The volume of the larger pyramid is \[1680\left(\frac{27}{8+27}\right)=1296\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[1680-1296=384\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac23(12)=8\text{ cm}.\] Let the side length of its square base be \(s\). Then \[\frac13s^2(8)=384\] so \[s^2=144,\qquad s=12.\] The slant height of each triangular face is \[\sqrt{8^2+6^2}=10.\] Thus the total surface area is \[144+4\left(\frac12(12)(10)\right)=384\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(1296\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(384\text{ cm}^2\).

questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的表面積比為 \(4:9\)，較大球半徑為 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小球的體積。

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。已知 \(A\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(6\) cm，某學生量得 \(B\) 的底半徑為 \(12\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: (a) Since the surface area ratio is \(4:9\), the radius ratio is \(2:3\), and the volume ratio is \(8:27\). Therefore \[V_{\text{smaller}}=\frac{8}{27}\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of \(A\) is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(10)=120\pi.\] The volume of \(B\) is \[288\pi+\frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3-120\pi=1140\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{V_B}{V_A}=\frac{1140\pi}{120\pi}=\frac{19}{2}.\] If \(A\) and \(B\) were similar, the volume ratio should be \[\left(\frac{12}{6}\right)^3=8.\] Since \(8\ne \frac{19}{2}\), \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. 14. The base radius and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are \(14\text{ cm}\) and \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times the curved surface area of \(X\).

(i) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(Y\) is melted and recast into 2 identical solid spheres, find the diameter of each sphere.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的底半徑及曲面面積分別為 \(14\) cm 及 \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的 \(15\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相同的實心球，求每個球的直徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(l\) be the slant height of the circular cone. Since the curved surface area is \(700\pi\), \[\pi(14)l=700\pi.\] Thus \[ l=50. \] The height is \[\sqrt{50^2-14^2}=48\text{ cm}.\] (b)(i) Since the curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times that of \(X\), the whole cone has curved surface area \(16\) times that of \(X\). Therefore the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \(1:4\), and the volume of \(X\) is \(\frac{1}{64}\) of the volume of the whole cone. The volume of the whole cone is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(14)^2(48)=3136\pi.\) Hence \(V_Y=3136\pi\left(1-\frac{1}{64}\right)=3087\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b)(ii) If the diameter of each sphere is \(d\), then \(2\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi\left(\frac{d}{2}\right)^3=3087\pi.\) Solving gives \(d=21.\) Final answers: (a) \(48\text{ cm}\); (b)(i) \(3087\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b)(ii) \(21\text{ cm}\).

(a) Express the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Express the total surface area of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) \(X\) is melted and recast into a solid cube. Does the total surface area of the cube exceed the total surface area of \(X\)? Explain your answer.

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的總表面積。

(c) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心立方體。立方體的總表面積是否超過 \(X\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。

questions.hintZh:

questions.solution: (a) The height of the small cone is \[45-30=15\text{ cm}.\] The small cone is similar to the original cone with linear scale factor \[\frac{15}{45}=\frac13.\] Therefore the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\left(\frac13\right)^3\right) =8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\text{ cm}.\] The radius and slant height of the small cone are respectively \[8\text{ cm} \text{and} 17\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17).\] The two circular faces have total area \[\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2.\] Hence the total surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17)+\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2 =1728\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (c) Let the side length of the cube be \(x\) cm. Since the volume is unchanged, \[x^3=8320\pi.\] Thus \[x\approx 29.6773.\] The total surface area of the cube is \[6x^2\approx 5284.45\text{ cm}^2.\] Also, \[1728\pi\approx 5428.67\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[5284.45<5428.67,\] the total surface area of the cube does not exceed the total surface area of \(X\). Final answers: (a) \(8320\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\); (c) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）小錐高 15，線性比 1/3：
\[

\]

\(r_1:r_2:r_3=2:3:5.\)

(a) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A craftsman finds that the height of \(Y\) is 9 cm.

(i) Find \(r_2\).
(ii) The craftsman claims that the total surface area of \(Z\) is greater than the surface area of the sphere. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
13. 一個半徑 \(10\) cm 的實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成三個相似的實心直立圓柱 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\)。設 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的底半徑分別為 \(r_1\)、\(r_2\)、\(r_3\) cm，已知 \(r_1:r_2:r_3=2:3:5\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。

(b) 某工匠量得 \(Y\) 的高為 \(9\) cm。

(i) 求 \(r_2\)。
(ii) 該工匠聲稱 \(Z\) 的總表面積大於球的表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。

questions.solution: (a) The volume of the original sphere is \[\frac43\pi(10)^3=\frac{4000\pi}{3}.\] Since the cylinders are similar and their linear ratio is \(2:3:5\), their volume ratio is \[2^3:3^3:5^3=8:27:125.\] Thus \[V_Y=\frac{27}{160}\cdot\frac{4000\pi}{3}=225\pi.\] (b)(i) \(\pi r_2^2(9)=225\pi\) \(r_2^2=25\) \(r_2=5.\) (b)(ii) Since \(r_2:r_3=3:5\), \(r_3=\frac53(5)=\frac{25}{3}.\) Since the cylinders are similar, \(h_Z=\frac53(9)=15.\) Total surface area of \(Z\): \(2\pi r_3^2+2\pi r_3h_Z =2\pi\left(\frac{25}{3}\right)^2+2\pi\left(\frac{25}{3}\right)(15) =\frac{3500\pi}{9}.\) Surface area of the sphere: \(4\pi(10)^2=400\pi.\) Since \(\frac{3500\pi}{9}<400\pi,\) the claim is not correct. (a) Find the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Find the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) The frustum \(Z\) is made by cutting off the upper part of \(Y\). The heights of \(X\) and \(Z\) are the same. Someone claims that the curved surface area of \(Z\) is twice the curved surface area of \(X\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(10\) cm、高 \(4.2\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 及 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9\)，\(Y\) 的底半徑與高之比為 \(3:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。

(c) 切除 \(Y\) 的上部造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的兩倍。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: The volume of the original cylinder is \(\pi(10)^2(4.2)=420\pi.\) Since the base areas of \(X\) and \(Y\) are in the ratio \(4:9\), their radii are in the ratio \(2:3\), so their volumes are in the ratio \(8:27\). (a) \[V_Y=420\pi\cdot\frac{27}{8+27}=\boxed{324\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the radius and height of \(Y\) be \(3k\) and \(4k\) respectively. Then \[\frac13\pi(3k)^2(4k)=324\pi,\] so \(12k^3=324\), \(k=3\). Hence \(r_Y=9\), \(h_Y=12\), and the slant height is \(15\). Therefore, \[\text{curved surface area of }Y=\pi(9)(15)=\boxed{135\pi\ \text{cm}^2}.\] (c) Since \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar, \(r_X=6\), \(h_X=8\), and the slant height of \(X\) is \(10\). Thus \[\text{CSA of }X=\pi(6)(10)=60\pi.\] In \(Y\), the frustum \(Z\) has height \(8\), so the removed top cone has height \(4\), with linear scale factor \(\frac{4}{12}=\frac13\). Its curved surface area is \[\frac{1}{9}(135\pi)=15\pi.\] Therefore, \[\text{CSA of }Z=135\pi-15\pi=120\pi=2(60\pi).\] The claim is correct.
